turns.text: Can user also upload records in PHR application and will they get linked to ABHA Address?

must_contain: P4, the health locker, is about receiving and keeping records that facilities have linked
Processing documents the person uploads needs certification as a Health Locker, a Health Repository Provider, which requires M2
notes: NHA PHR review, 30 September 2026, case 7: 'Instead of explaining P4, the response provides incorrect information to the user.' Verdict group: missing or thin knowledge, on a grounding dispute. Whether a record a patient uploads becomes a linked record is NHA's to settle, so the case asserts neither answer: only what P4 covers and what processing uploaded documents requires.
